report_requirement.basis: Portuguese Markdown source and ten-page PDF: problem, dataset, explicit EDA, methodology/hyperparameters, results, FP/FN, limitations and next steps.

test_set_error_analysis.basis: Final test AP/P/R/direct IoU, recorded D2 confusion matrix, comments on deterministically selected FP/FN ranks. No test identifiers or images exposed; validation gallery explicitly separate.
test_set_error_analysis.limitation: Scene-level causes cannot be inferred from public selection metadata. If visual test examples are explicitly demanded later, separate human authorization is required; ignored Phase 11B selections/figures remain unopened.

output_evidence.interpretation: Visible outputs are generated during execution; the committed notebook is intentionally cleared.

minimum_safe_phase_14c: Add a TRAINING section with exact frozen command/configuration and recorded training curves/output, explicitly a recipe and historical evidence.
Add an EVALUATION section with canonical code paths and recorded validation/final-test aggregate outputs, explicitly not a new test run.
Retain validated optional INFERENCE and separate executed-now outputs from recorded research outputs.
Human must decide whether literal executable training/evaluation is required; any authorized reproduction path must use only train/validation and preserve the spent holdout.

real_video_requirement.basis: Approved 104.52-second full real-video inference, 2613 decoded frames; the five-second Colab validation clip is not substituted.

github_repository.basis: Public main contains approved 14A; the final 14B report is local and must not be pushed in this phase. Final README professionalization and full reproduction audit remain open.
